summary.text: Tolaria is a legendary island on Dominaria, home of the original Tolarian Academy, which was ruined in the Obliteration of Tolaria and succeeded by the Academy at Tolaria West.

bio.text: Urza and Barrin founded the Tolarian Academy on Tolaria, admitting only children.
Karn used Urza's time machine to save Jhoira from a Phyrexian sleeper agent, and the machine failed catastrophically, destroying the academy and leaving a shattered temporal landscape.

Urza and Barrin escaped with thirteen others and Karn rescued thirty-three more, leaving Jhoira stranded, and ten years later they returned to find Jhoira alive and Teferi trapped in a slow-time bubble.
The Invasion of Tolaria began while Urza was away, and was ended by Barrin, Jhoira, Teferi and their allies.
Urza secretly began the Bloodline Project there to create mortal heroes to wield the Legacy against Yawgmoth.
After Phyrexians swarmed the island, Barrin sealed Hanna in a sarcophagus and obliterated Tolaria with a massive spell, annihilating every living thing on it, and the island sank beneath the waves.
Scholars later founded Tolaria West, and its campus was taken over by the Society of Mishra, while the island academy fell to the Phyrexians in Dominaria United.

status.text: The latest stories show Tolaria falling to the Phyrexians and the Society of Mishra taking the Academy, after which the campus was destroyed and the Academy recovered.
